incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated capacity saturation detected — eu-west-1 pool 'dedicated-eu-wk-3' p99 latency breach > 2s for 5m, queue depth spiking
incident-bot: severity=page, incident_id=INC-20260315-01, affected_routes=[/v1/chat, /v1/generate], impact=customer-visible
alice (oncall-sre): acked. I'm on the page. pulling metrics and recent deploys.
alice (oncall-sre): quick check: autoscaler events show scale-up requested at 1769777660 but new nodes not Ready until 1769777788 — warmup delay ~128s
bob (eng-runtime): looking at runtime logs — we see many warmup failures for hotshot slots (kv-cache coldpath). snippet: ```2026-03-15T12:45:21Z ERROR warmup: slot_init timeout 30s pool=dedicated-eu-wk-3 model=redwood-v2-13b```
alice (oncall-sre): p95 jumped from 120ms -> 780ms, p99 -> 2.3s according to console. Streaming stalls reported by some customers (partial tokens, then long gap).
carol (platform): autoscaler telemetry: handshake_rtt to pool manager increased, suspected control-plane congestion. There's also an increased backlog on provisioner queue (queue_depth=312, backlog_rate=+400req/min).
dave (support): rolled in first customer reports at 12:44 UTC — user-facing slowdowns, some sessions timed out. Escalating to account team. Customer luis (ops) posted evidence in support ticket.
luis (customer-ops): "We saw streaming stalls on critical flows around 12:44-12:47, many requests returned 500 after a retry. This is impacting our payment flow."
alice (oncall-sre): mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback routing to hosted pool for non-sensitive routes 2) temporarily increase priority queue share for hotshot customers 3) manual scale-up of dedicated pool if control-plane not recovering
bob (eng-runtime): applying fallback routing rule now for /v1/generate (non-PII). command: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/route/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","target":"hosted-eu"}'`
bob (eng-runtime): rollback: rule applied, traffic diverting. observing drop in queue depth from 312 -> 90 in next minute.
alice (oncall-sre): can we also lower instance warmup timeout to allow faster replacement? current slot_init timeout=30s. Maybe set to 20s while we stabilize.
carol (platform): ack. setting slot_init_timeout=20s for autoscaler for this pool (temporary). also triggering manual scale to add 4 nodes.
carol (platform): manual scale requested at 1769777768, new nodes started provisioning. one node failed healthcheck at 1769777810 (nvlink warmup issue) — replacing.
dave (support): notifying customer luis that we routed non-sensitive traffic to hosted fallback and are escalating for payment flow priority. template: "We detected a capacity issue and are diverting traffic; engineers are actively mitigating. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA."
luis (customer-ops): thanks, please flag if we should throttle non-critical flows on our side.
alice (oncall-sre): current SLO snapshot: p95=680ms, p99=1.9s; streaming stall events reduced by ~60% since fallback. still elevated but trending down.
bob (eng-runtime): added short-term KV prefill job for hot models to prime caches on new nodes. running now. logs: `prefill: model=redwood-v2-13b started shards=4`
eve (pager): paging policy: will escalate to eng-runtime lead if p99 > 2s for another 10m.
alice (oncall-sre): timeline and actions so far: 12:43 alert, 12:44 page, 12:45 fallback routing, 12:46 manual scale requested, 12:47 KV prefill started, 12:49 queue depth halved, 12:50 p99 under 2s but still above baseline.
carol (platform): control-plane logs indicate a burst of reconcile ops at 12:42 caused etcd CPU spin on the cluster managing the dedicated pools — this delayed node readiness. capturing logs for postmortem.
alice (oncall-sre): immediate customer impact: multiple customers saw elevated latency and a few 500s. we've diverted non-sensitive traffic; for sensitive routes we are prioritizing hotshot queues and working with provisioning.
dave (support): creating incident summary for customers now and linking support ticket IDs.
bob (eng-runtime): action items for next hour: 1) ensure replacements finish, 2) monitor KV hitrate, 3) validate handshake_rtt recovered.
alice (oncall-sre): assigning RCA and postmortem to bob + carol. please include autoscaler handshake latency, control-plane reconcile storm root cause, and mitigation checklist (fallback playbook, prefill job as runbook item).
carol (platform): creating a postmortem doc and will schedule blameless review. tentative owner: carol.
alice (oncall-sre): closing the page to oncall; we'll maintain status channel and update incident ticket. if p99 regresses will re-page. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident INC-20260315-01 updated: status=mitigated, severity=page->investigating, incident_channel=#inc-1769777770-inc-20260315-01
